title: The Noble act of the old man
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：noble　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 noble 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the cook wrote of ① a noble act of the old man in the menu, and everybody in the canteen said at once that it was ② nobler than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the cook, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the noble ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the noblest act of the old man anybody in the canteen had ever seen, or so the menu for September 1946 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too noble to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the guest who had come to help; the noble ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a noble family of the region, and said that no guest in his right mind would call it ⑥ as noble as the family of the region they had once had in the old canteen. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was noble or not, and he said so.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the menu. What the line asked for was ⑦ something noble, and nothing besides. The guest from the next canteen called the whole plan ⑧ quite noble; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the menu kept the names of the noble ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962, without complaint, she wrote of another noble act of the old man in the same menu, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ nobler than anybody had expected. ⑩ The noblest family of the region in the whole canteen, she said in 1964, was the one she could never quite name; the noble ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 高尚（前置定语 a noble act of the old man：1952 年厨子在菜单里记下的那件高尚的行为）
B. adj. 高尚／贵族（比较级 nobler than：文中两处，一处比老人高尚的行为，一处比预想）
C. adj. 高尚／贵族（最高级 the noblest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 高尚（表语 too noble to do：母亲觉得它太高尚，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 贵族（前置定语 a noble family of the region：叔叔把整件事称作一桩贵族的世家）
F. adj. 贵族（同级比较 as noble as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩当地的贵族世家相比）
G. adj. 贵族（后置定语 something noble：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 贵族（受程度副词修饰 quite noble：那位客人的评价）

items.q: a noble act of the old man
the noblest act of the old man anybody
a noble family of the region
The noblest family of the region in

answers.why: noble 意为“高尚”，1952 年厨子在菜单里记下的是“一件高尚的行为”，此处作前置定语 a noble act of the old man。
noble 意为“高尚”，此处用比较级 nobler than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
noble 意为“高尚”，菜单上 九月 那行字说它是食堂里最高尚的一件，故用最高级 the noblest act of the old man。
noble 意为“高尚”，母亲认为这件东西“太高尚了，谁也用不上”，too noble to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
noble 意为“贵族”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩贵族的世家”，此处作前置定语 a noble family of the region。
noble 意为“贵族”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩当地的贵族世家一样贵族”，同级比较用 as noble as。
noble 意为“贵族”，菜单上那半行字要的是“贵族的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something noble。
noble 意为“贵族”，邻食堂来的那位客人认为这套计划“相当贵族”，quite 修饰原级 noble。
noble 意为“贵族”，1962 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要贵族”，故用比较级 nobler than。
noble 意为“贵族”，母亲 1964 年说的是“整个食堂里最贵族的那一桩”，故用最高级 the noblest family of the region。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，厨子在菜单里记下了一件高尚的行为。（a noble act of the old man）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更高尚。（nobler than …）
母亲觉得它太高尚，谁也用不上。（too noble to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩贵族的世家。（a noble family of the region）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩当地的贵族世家一样贵族。（as noble as …）
到了 1959 年，菜单上只剩半行字：要的是一件贵族的东西。（something noble）
answers: In 1952 the cook wrote of a noble act of the old man in the menu.
Everybody said it was nobler than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too noble to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a noble family of the region.
He said nobody would call it as noble as the family of the region they had once had.
By 1959 the menu asked for nothing but something noble.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 noble 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the cook wrote of a noble act of the old man in the menu, and nobody forgot it.
It was the noblest act of the old man in the canteen, or so the menu says.
My mother thought it too noble to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a noble family of the region, and nobody argued with him.
The guest from the next canteen called the plan quite noble, and everybody laughed.
The noble ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
